version: LOCK 52 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - side mission: Two brothers not speaking
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner; LOCK 3 and LOCK 6 regulars; River Market places (LOCK 1). Each mission is its own LOCK and queue line.

missions.title: Two brothers not speaking
missions.kicker: River Market · Two brothers not speaking
missions.button: Adil is complaining about his brother

a.text: Adil and Hamza haven't spoken since their father died and left them his shop. Adil tells you Hamza cheated him. Later Hamza tells you Adil is a fool. Each one asks: “What did he say about me?”

choices.label: Tell each one the other still cares for him
Tell each exactly what the other said

peace.text: You tell Adil his brother misses their father's shop with him in it. You tell Hamza his brother speaks of him every day - which is true, in its way. A week later they are drinking tea together outside the shop.

worse.text: Each brother hears every word. Now they don't even walk on the same side of the street.

out.text: The brothers go on not speaking.

peace: Brought Adil and Hamza back together
